claims: The 2026 Oscars ceremony is the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony takes place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony starts live at 7:00 p.m. ET / 4:00 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is hosted by Conan O'Brien.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony broadcasts from the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony broadcasts on ABC and Hulu.
The Official Red Carpet Show for Oscars 2026 starts at 6:30 p.m. ET / 3:30 p.m. PT on ABC/Hulu.
The Early Red Carpet Coverage for Oscars 2026 starts at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT.
The TV channel for Oscars 2026 is ABC.
The streaming options for Oscars 2026 are Hulu, FuboTV, YouTubeTV, and ABC App.
The 2026 Oscars show is expected to run for approximately 3.5 hours.
